subject.title: Gateway should expose HTTP REST endpoints for common queries

question: Should read-only session query access be added to the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, or should OpenClaw own new dedicated GET REST endpoints for this Gateway data?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent HTTP API shape and bearer-authenticated session-data exposure boundary require maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Expand admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Add `sessions.list`, `sessions.describe`, and `sessions.get` to the default-off admin HTTP RPC allowlist with docs and tests, avoiding a second HTTP control surface.

options.title: Add dedicated REST endpoints
options.body: Implement `/api` or `/v1` read-only session endpoints over existing handlers when maintainers want a fetch-friendly public REST contract.

options.title: Keep current surfaces
options.body: Document WebSocket RPC and the current admin HTTP RPC methods as the supported integration paths and leave session query HTTP access absent.

recommendation.title: Expand admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Add `sessions.list`, `sessions.describe`, and `sessions.get` to the default-off admin HTTP RPC allowlist with docs and tests, avoiding a second HTTP control surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent admin HTTP RPC, Gateway HTTP routing, and prior review history for the exact product/API boundary.
